title: Silhouette Paneling
description: Style graphique vectoriel plat présentant des silhouettes noires unies sur des blocs de couleurs unies et sourdes. Caractérisé par des bords nets et précis, une composition structurelle en grille et l'absence totale de dégradés ou de détails internes.
description_en: Flat vector graphic style featuring solid black silhouettes against unshaded, muted color blocks. Characterized by crisp, razor-sharp edges, a grid-like structural composition, and a complete absence of gradients or internal detailing.
description_fr: Style graphique vectoriel plat présentant des silhouettes noires unies sur des blocs de couleurs unies et sourdes. Caractérisé par des bords nets et précis, une composition structurelle en grille et l'absence totale de dégradés ou de détails internes.
prompt: Flat vector digital graphic illustration featuring solid black silhouettes set against stark, unshaded color blocks. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The entire foreground composition, including all primary elements, figures, and structural lines, must be rendered in pure, solid black with zero internal detailing, hatching, or shading. The background consists of geometric, flat panels of {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}}, utilizing {{accent_color}} for stark contrast. Lighting is entirely flat and 2D, relying on a pure backlight aesthetic where the colored background illuminates the stark black foreground elements. Texture is flawlessly smooth, mathematical, and pristine, completely devoid of grain, noise, brushstrokes, or gradients. Edges are razor-sharp, precisely cut vector contours creating high-contrast boundaries between the black silhouettes and the colored negative space. The composition utilizes a structured, grid-like division of space, reminiscent of architectural cross-sections or comic book paneling, to organize the visual narrative. Depth is strictly implied through flat overlapping shapes rather than perspective. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners. Reinforcement tags: flat vector, minimalist silhouette, solid black foreground, crisp edges, unshaded color blocks, 2D graphic design, grid composition, high contrast, geometric framing, pure backlight, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame.
